title: System Layout and Integration
description: System Layout and Integration as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Is space allocated for the route, including maintenance access?
Are the installation's spatial interfaces with other Systems identified?
Thermal (environment): are heat sources near the installation and temperature limits identified?
Thermal (environment): are heat sources near fuel lines identified and fuel temperature limits stated?
Is the preliminary layout clash-free in the integrated model?
Are routing corridors agreed with the interfacing Systems?
Thermal (environment): is fuel temperature at the engine interface within limits under ground heat soak?
Are all routing clearances confirmed in the integrated model?
Are clearances to moving parts and thermal sources confirmed?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
